name: Having Fun
overview: Scripture affirms that enjoying life and rejoicing in God’s blessings is a good and God-ordained part of living. Believers are encouraged to find joy and gladness in their work and fellowship, celebrating with glad hearts and even dance as expressions of praise (Deuteronomy 12:7; Psalms 149:3). A merry heart is depicted as beneficial to both spirit and body, likened to medicine that brings cheerfulness and health (Proverbs 15:13; Proverbs 17:22). Ultimately, the enjoyment of good things in life, such as eating, drinking, and rejoicing, is recognized as a gift from God to delight and refresh the soul (Ecclesiastes 2:24; Job 8:21).
